# Union Vet

> Union Vet (Union Vet NY) is a modern animal hospital in Oakland Gardens, Queens, New York, providing fast same-day emergency care plus wellness exams, vaccinations, surgery and advanced diagnostics for dogs, cats and all pets. Open late until 8 PM on weekdays.

## Contact & hours
- Address: 222-10 Union Tpke, Oakland Gardens, NY 11364
- Phone / text: (718) 301-4030
- Email: info@unionvetny.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday 8 AM–8 PM, Saturday 8 AM–4 PM, Sunday closed
- Service area: Oakland Gardens, Bayside, Fresh Meadows, Queens Village, and the wider Queens, NY area

## Services
- Urgent & emergency care — fast same-day treatment for injuries and illnesses
- Wellness & new-pet exams for puppies, kittens and adult pets
- Vaccinations (core and lifestyle-based, including rabies and Bordetella)
- Diagnostics & imaging — in-house laboratory, digital X-ray, ultrasound, echocardiogram
- Surgery — spay/neuter, soft-tissue and orthopedic procedures
- Dental care
- Nutritional counseling (Hill's and Royal Canin prescription diets)
- Microchipping, senior pet care, and domestic & international health certificates

## Booking & pharmacy
- Book an appointment online through the clinic's secure scheduling portal, or call (718) 301-4030.
- Order medications, preventives and prescription diets through the Union Vet Online Pharmacy.
